category.description: Supply and installation of solar panels on and adjacent to private dwellings, housing and public and other buildings used for activities in the public interest

vatRateResults.comment: Tabel II prov. a.10: A zero rate is applicable for the supply and installation of solar panels [panels that have the function of generating electricity from sunlight with photovoltaic cells (also known as PV cells or solar cells)] on and adjacent to private dwellings.
